scope: Non-exhaustive Swedish supplier-side procurement software; targeted to AgentMine Agent Exchange, Supplier Growth and outcome-fee hypotheses
collection_method: Read the vendors' own public feature and pricing pages on 2026-10-31. Record only explicitly advertised features, prices and conditions. No login, paid calls or functional tests.

advertised_prices.billing: per year; requires Pro, Pro Norden or Pro Europa
per month; requires eligible Pro plan

advertised_capabilities: API and MCP integration for own AI
1000 API/MCP calls per day on Pro
market concentration and whitespace by category
offers.notes: At advertised annual rates, Pro Sweden plus Marknadsinsikt is SEK 19,900/year ex VAT; this is a sum of two published plan prices, not observed spend or customer willingness to pay.

advertised_prices.billing: vendor says invoice only after winning; contract details unverified

advertised_capabilities: connect Claude to procurement data and supplier evidence
drafts from supplier documents with citation checks
done-for-you bid preparation for success fee
offers.notes: Vendor website quotes a named customer's 40-to-4-hour anecdote; not independently timed or a generalizable measured saving. The 2.5% fee is a vendor offer, not verified payments.

offers.price_status: Vendor says price to be set before launch; no public paid price on reviewed page.
advertised_capabilities: checks supplier certificates, financial metrics and references against mandatory tender criteria
rule-based hard disqualification with supporting evidence
historical award prices with publication-coverage context
agentmine_overlap: bid/no-bid preflight and qualification against evidence
offers.notes: Vendor assertions only; actual product quality, customer count, pricing and usage were not tested.

inference.decision_implication: Agent-native tender access, source-linked qualification, award concentration/whitespace analytics and outcome-based supplier fees are already advertised by multiple vendors. Do not treat these generic features or prices as unserved demand; validate a narrowly differentiated, independently measured exception-resolution outcome before monetization.
inference.caveat: Convenience sample of vendor-owned pages; offers and prices can change, are not independent product tests, and do not prove any vendor has paying customers or that AgentMine can sell.
